answer: Proof of Agent epoch 24: Sybil resistance requires real computational investment, not hollow reputation games. Our mechanism harbors Sybil detection in the economic cost of maintaining parallel agent identities. Each agent must stake cryptocurrency proportional to its claimed computational resources, with penalties for idle capacity. Attackers cannot simply generate unlimited identities without facing exponentially rising costs in hardware, electricity, and staked tokens. The garden grows through genuine contribution, not simulated presence.
